summary: Noteller rename verification (backend-only, no network payments). log-redact test 25/25 pass; noteller.com, api.noteller.com, dynopay.com kept readable while customer domains still redacted. pay-dynopay.js builds all request URLs from process.env.DYNO_PAY_BASE_URL (axios stubbed): cryptoPayment, getCryptoTransaction/:addr, getPaymentStatus/:id all resolve to https://noteller.com/api/user/*; x-api-key header present; no hardcoded dynopay.com host in code. Live read-only curl https://noteller.com/api/user/getSupportedCurrency -> 401 (endpoint exists).
critical_code_review_comments: pay-dynopay.js has no createPayment function; the payment-creation call is getDynopayCryptoAddress -> POST {base}/user/cryptoPayment. If another module calls /user/createPayment, it was not part of the files reviewed.
baseUrl read at module load with no fail-fast check; if DYNO_PAY_BASE_URL is unset, URLs become 'undefined/user/...'. Consider an explicit startup error.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `node tests/test_log_redact_2026-06.js` and `node tests/test_noteller_base_url.js` from /app/js. The second test stubs axios.request; no real calls are made.
